description.text:
Fine-tuned Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 · QLoRA · Domain-Specific Adaptation

Fine-tuned by SpaceXerror as part of ongoing research on domain-specific LLM adaptation for mental health support.

This model was developed as part of a research paper investigating the effectiveness of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods — specifically QLoRA — for adapting large language models to mental health support tasks.

serving.text_only_input_quote: print(chat("I have been feeling very anxious lately. What can I do?"))
serving.system_prompt:
You are a compassionate, empathetic mental health support assistant.
You listen carefully, validate feelings, and provide thoughtful, evidence-based guidance.
Always prioritize the person's safety and wellbeing.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets only bos_token_id and eos_token_id. The sampling values are from the card example, which also sets no_repeat_ngram_size to 4. Training max sequence length on the card is 512. config.json max_position_embeddings is 32768. tokenizer_config.json has a Mistral chat template and use_default_system_prompt false; the system prompt above is the card example, not text baked into the template. The repository has merged float16 weights (Hub safetensors total 7248023552) and no adapter_config.json. mindspace.zip is 29109 bytes and was not opened. The card also says batch size 2 with an effective batch of 16 (gradient accumulation 8).

evaluation_reported.text: Final Train Loss 0.8180. Final Val Loss 0.7862. Perplexity 2.451 on 200 samples. The card says: Perplexity of 2.451 is considered excellent for domain-specific mental health conversational AI.

discrepancies: Inventory lists full_finetune and qlora. The card states QLoRA (4-bit NF4) with SFTTrainer, then a merge into the base. The sentence 'QLoRA enables full fine-tuning of 7B models on 2× Tesla T4 GPUs' is about QLoRA, not a full-weight update. Datasets and parent match the card. The card's used counts (2,598 and 4,527) are smaller than the Hub datasets (2,775 and 99,086 rows).
